## CSV-FILE-EMPTY

**CSV file is empty** — severity `error`, scope `csv-structure`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

The file has no content: 0 bytes, or only a byte-order mark and/or whitespace.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#csv-file-empty> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## CSV-FILE-BINARY

**File is a binary format, not CSV text** — severity `error`, scope `csv-structure`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

The leading bytes identify a binary format such as an Excel .xlsx/.xls workbook, PDF, ZIP or image. Export the sheet as 'CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)' instead.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#csv-file-binary> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## CSV-NUL-BYTE

**File contains NUL bytes** — severity `error`, scope `csv-structure`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

The file contains NUL (0x00) bytes, typical of UTF-16 text or binary data. Row checks are skipped.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#csv-nul-byte> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## CSV-ENCODING-BOM

**UTF-8 byte-order mark present (accepted)** — severity `info`, scope `csv-structure`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

A UTF-8 byte-order mark (EF BB BF) starts the file. Excel's 'CSV UTF-8' format writes one; StockMetaLint accepts it and excludes it from header names.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#csv-encoding-bom> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## CSV-MALFORMED

**Malformed CSV structure** — severity `error`, scope `csv-structure`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

A record could not be parsed: for example an unterminated quoted field, text after a closing quote, or a field larger than 128 KiB. Parsing stops at the first malformed record; earlier rows are still checked.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4180> (updated: 2005-10)
- Verification: `standard-reference`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## CSV-ROW-FIELD-COUNT

**Record has the wrong number of fields** — severity `error`, scope `csv-structure`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

A record has a different number of fields than the header. Unquoted commas inside Keywords are the usual cause: the whole keyword list must be one double-quoted cell. Rows with extra fields are not content-checked because their columns cannot be aligned reliably.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4180> (updated: 2005-10)
- Verification: `standard-reference`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## CSV-BLANK-ROW

**Blank record between data rows** — severity `warning`, scope `csv-structure`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

A blank or all-empty record appears after the header. StockMetaLint skips it and does not count it as a data row, but other tools may count or reject it.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#csv-blank-row> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## META-WHITESPACE

**Leading or trailing whitespace** — severity `info`, scope `hygiene`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

A cell starts or ends with whitespace. In Filename this can prevent exact asset matching.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#meta-whitespace> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: `trim-whitespace`
- Notes: The trim-whitespace fix never modifies Filename cells; rename consistently instead.

## META-CONTROL-CHAR

**Control character in a cell** — severity `warning`, scope `hygiene`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

A cell contains a tab, line break or other control character (for example a multi-line title inside quotes).

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#meta-control-char> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## META-UNICODE-NFC

**Text is not Unicode NFC** — severity `info`, scope `hygiene`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

Text is not in Unicode Normalization Form C, so visually identical strings can differ in bytes (common for accented names created on macOS).

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr15/> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `standard-reference`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: `nfc`
- Notes: The nfc fix applies to Title and Keywords only, never to Filename.

## META-LENGTH-UTF16

**Over a length limit when counted in UTF-16 units** — severity `warning`, scope `hygiene`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

The value is within its limit in Unicode code points but over it in UTF-16 code units, which is what HTML form maxlength counts (emoji and other astral characters count as two).

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#attr-fe-maxlength> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `standard-reference`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —
- Notes: Which unit Adobe's backend counts is not documented; this advisory flags the ambiguity.

## META-FILENAME-PORTABILITY

**Filename is not portable across operating systems** — severity `warning`, scope `hygiene`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

The filename uses characters or names that are invalid on Windows: < > : " | ? *, control characters, reserved device names such as CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1 or LPT1, or a trailing dot or space.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#meta-filename-portability> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## META-KEYWORD-DUPLICATE

**Duplicate keyword in a row** — severity `warning`, scope `hygiene`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

The same keyword appears more than once in a row, compared case-insensitively after collapsing whitespace. Original spellings and order are preserved in the report.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#meta-keyword-duplicate> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: `dedupe-keywords`

## META-KEYWORD-DUPLICATE-NFKC

**Keywords identical after NFKC normalization** — severity `info`, scope `hygiene`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

Two keywords differ only by Unicode compatibility forms (for example full-width and ASCII letters, or ligatures). Reported as a suggestion; originals are never altered.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr15/> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `standard-reference`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

**Empty keyword item** — severity `warning`, scope `hygiene`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

The Keywords cell contains empty items, e.g. 'sky,,sun', a leading comma or a trailing comma.

## META-KEYWORD-SEPARATOR

**Keyword contains a non-comma separator** — severity `warning`, scope `heuristic`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

HEURISTIC: a keyword contains a semicolon, vertical bar, or a non-ASCII comma (full-width, ideographic or Arabic). Keywords are separated by ASCII commas, so this is probably several keywords that will be read as one.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#meta-keyword-separator> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## META-KEYWORD-LOW-VALUE

**Technical or filler keyword in the first 10** — severity `info`, scope `heuristic`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

HEURISTIC: one of the first 10 keywords looks like technical data or a generic filler term (file type, resolution, camera setting, 'stock photo'). The word list is StockMetaLint's own; it cannot judge relevance and is only a suggestion.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://github.com/hanifwidi/stockmetalint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#meta-keyword-low-value> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `tool-defined`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —
- Notes: Related Adobe guidance: the CSV requirements page asks contributors not to include technical data in keywords.

## SEC-FORMULA-PREFIX

**Cell could be executed as a spreadsheet formula** — severity `warning`, scope `security`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

A cell starts with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return (or with = + - @ after spaces). If the CSV is opened in a spreadsheet, the cell may be evaluated as a formula. StockMetaLint never writes such cells unescaped in fix output.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/CSV_Injection> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `standard-reference`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —

## SEC-INVISIBLE-CHAR

**Bidirectional control or invisible character** — severity `warning`, scope `security`, profiles `standard`, `editorial`.

Text contains bidirectional control characters (e.g. U+202E) or invisible characters (e.g. U+200B) that can disguise what is displayed. In Filename, zero-width joiners are reported too.

- Limit: —
- Source: <https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr36/> (updated: unknown)
- Verification: `standard-reference`; verified at: not verified
- Fix rule: —
